description: SSOT for editorial color tokens. Brand identity, grays, and neutral palette. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-color-brand-primary.role: Brand Primary — Logo, headlines, accents, brand identity

TK-color-gray-50.role: Subtle background, card surfaces — neutral-50 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-100.role: Section backgrounds, hover states — neutral-100 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-200.role: Borders, dividers, disabled states — neutral-200 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-300.role: Placeholder backgrounds, subtle separators — neutral-300 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-400.role: Placeholder text, secondary icons — neutral-400 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-500.role: Disabled text, inactive controls — neutral-500 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-600.role: Secondary text, captions — neutral-600 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-700.role: Medium-emphasis body text — neutral-700 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-800.role: Body text, high-emphasis content — neutral-800 per identity.html

TK-color-gray-900.role: Highest emphasis text, dark surfaces — neutral-900 per identity.html
